title: QM geometry-signal pilot: QM7 (composition) + QM9-mu (geometry-pure), 7-arm geometry/architecture decomposition + matched RF ceiling
question: Does 3D (Uni-Mol pair_repr) injection extract a real geometry signal where geometry IS the signal (QM9 dipole), and does it beat the fingerprint/descriptor ceiling?
coordinate_provenance_CAVEAT: CRITICAL: this pilot fed Uni-Mol RDKit-MMFF conformers (prepare_qm9mu_unimol_input.py:98 EmbedMolecule(randomSeed=42) + :102 MMFFOptimizeMolecule), NOT the true GDB-9 DFT-optimized coordinates. So every 'geometry' finding below is MMFF geometry, not real DFT geometry. Hamakawa2025 / Adams&Coley show wrong/approximate conformers can collapse the geometry signal. The make-or-break 'does REAL 3D help on a geometry-pure target' cell (Uni-Mol fed true GDB-9 DFT coords, end-to-end finetune) is NOT done here -- it is the Stage-2 deciding experiment in plan shiny-hugging-glacier.md. Read all 'real geometry' / 'reads geometry' wording below as 'reads MMFF geometry'.

protocol.deep: finetune, epochs 1000 pretrain + ft_max_epochs 40 / patience 15, batch 1024, K 10, hid_dim 512, eval_seeds 9/19/29, RMSE on test split. NOTE: Uni-Mol pair_repr extracted on RDKit-MMFF conformers, not DFT coords (see coordinate_provenance_CAVEAT).
protocol.geometry_effect: real_arm - matched_random_arm (negative = real Uni-Mol geometry helps beyond architecture)
protocol.architecture_effect: random_arm - V0 (effect of the injection ARCHITECTURE with geometry destroyed by pair shuffling)
protocol.rf: matched split via manifest (deep's exact train/test, embed_ok molecules only); Morgan(1024)+descriptors; RandomForestRegressor(300) seeds 9/19/29; weak11=composition descriptors, strongFull=full RDKit ~210 incl Gasteiger partial-charge descriptors
protocol.rf_note: RF evaluated on test only (1473 for qm9mu / 684 for qm7) to match deep's reported metric exactly; valid left out of both

qm7.verdict: RF (99-105) DOMINATES all deep arms (137-149) by ~38. T7's -11.7 gain over V0 is ~92% ARCHITECTURE (T7random alone -10.8); real geometry only -0.9. T8 splits 5.1 arch + 3.5 geom. Atomization energy ~ sum of atom contributions -> count/composition RF wins; 3D adds almost nothing.

qm9mu.verdict: ONLY T8 extracts a geometry-ISOLATED signal (MMFF geometry -- see coordinate_provenance_CAVEAT, NOT DFT): T8 0.966 << T8random 0.999 ~= V0 0.993 (T8_geom -0.033, ~3.3% rel, ~3 sigma at n=3); T8 architecture alone (+0.006) does NOT help -> the gain is MMFF geometry. T7/V2T5/random ~= V0 (no geometry). BUT strong charge-aware RF (0.925) still BEATS best deep (T8 0.966) by 0.042 -> even geometry-pure mu does not break the fingerprint/descriptor ceiling. UNRESOLVED: whether true DFT coords amplify T8_geom enough to clear the RF ceiling is the Stage-2 deciding experiment, not answered here.

decision_gate.gate_a_detail: Geometry effect on mu (T8 -0.033, geometry-isolated) is CLEANER than QM7 (T8 -3.5 confounded w/ 5.1 arch), but RF still dominates deep on BOTH datasets -> gate-a fails on the RF condition.
decision_gate.gate_b_detail: Strong charge-RF 0.925 < deep T8 0.966 -> RF does NOT collapse; the descriptor ceiling stays above deep even on geometry-pure mu.
decision_gate.branch: C (mixed): a REAL but modest, mechanism-gated (T8-only) geometry effect exists on mu, yet the fingerprint/descriptor RF ceiling remains above deep across the whole geometry-signal spectrum.
decision_gate.action: Report honestly; do NOT burn big compute. Strengthens C1 (descriptor saturation) and adds a precise positive sub-finding (T8 is the only mechanism that reads real geometry, only where geometry is the whole signal).

followups_flagged_not_auto_run: qm9gap (15k, same 7 arms): confirm T8 geometry effect is not a dipole-specific fluke -- second geometry-pure target. Low cost.
n=3 -> n=5 (add seeds 39,49) on V0/T8/T8random for mu: firm up the -0.033 (~3 sigma at n=3) effect. Low cost.
raw interatomic-distance injection (dist_to_edge_weight) vs 64-d Uni-Mol pair_repr on mu: test whether the learned pair_repr is a bottleneck for reading geometry. NEW WORK -- flag only.
paper_implication: Across the geometry-signal spectrum (saturated ADMET [prior] -> composition QM7 -> geometry-pure QM9 dipole), a fingerprint/descriptor RF matches or beats deep 3D-injection. 3D injection extracts a geometry signal ONLY on the geometry-pure dipole and ONLY through the richest mechanism (T8 atom<->pair co-update, ~3% RMSE, geometry-isolated, ~3 sigma), and even there stays below a cheap charge-aware RF. CAVEAT: this used MMFF (not DFT) conformers; the true-DFT-coord cell is the unmade Stage-2 deciding bet. Honest diagnostic result; AAAI-readiness conditional on Stage-2.
